I saved the draft for Hollis Mbeki at hmbeki@pemberline.com. It hasn't been sent.

- **Subject:** "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Body:** The proposed 2027 rate is $2,356 a seat, as Dana passed on to you, and you've cleared sharing it with him.

Hollis is internal, so this didn't need Ruth's approval. Rates normally go only to finance, the deal desk and the account owner, but as CFO you can approve sharing them, and you did. I took the $2,356 figure from your message and didn't check it against any account records.
